nodes.drugie.options.[stolica].text.t: I marched with the school to the capital. We never got there.

nodes.drugie.text.t: "Lost? Through the marshes, in your school's colours, with someone else's blood on your sleeves." The commander sniffs round you like a hound. "Lost men don't stink like that. Where are you coming from and where to, because this tale doesn't hang together."

nodes.odmowa.text.t: The commander shrugs. "Your choice. They're not my sheep, they're imperial. But coin's coin, and the door's open."

nodes.przybycie.options.[pyskowka].text.t: Who's asking? Your soup's going cold.

nodes.przybycie.text.t: The commander lifts his head from his spilt soup and looks you over from boots to forelock. "Look at him. A ragamuffin, and he strolled through my gate like it was his own yard. Who the fuck are you? You're not from round here, that's for sure."

nodes.trzecie.text.t: The commander says nothing for a long time, chewing his moustache. "Fine. I'll not ask more, because the answer'd be worse than the question. But since you're here and eating my soup, you'll work it off."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: "Right. Go while the wolves are hungry, not rabid." The commander goes back to his soup as if you'd never been there.

nodes.zlecenie.text.t: "A pack from the gully's been carrying off our sheep from under the palisade. Wipe it out and I'll pay twenty-five groats. A day's walk up the stream. Bring the ears for proof, because I trust a wanderer's word like I trust March weather."
